_doc: LANCE-19 batch 1: Centipede scout car, wheeled (RGriffin65). Four axles; the front axle steers. Wheel centres read off a side view of the level fit.
notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19, 2026-10-30), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. WHEELED kit (8 wheels, four axles). The fit is level (`no_icp` in centipede_veh.json; the v1 ICP tilted it) and lowered 182 mm onto the ground. The kit's fused hull was split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (centipede_prep.json) into the hull and the roof turret (`Centipede_turret`: the dome with its antennas, which turns about the vertical axis; the v1 box for it missed once the fit was level). The eight wheels (`wheel_l0`..`wheel_r3`) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`: tyre drum, recessed rim, hub boss, bolts) on axles fitted to the kit's wheel domes, which were cut from the hull; the front pair sits under `steer_l0` / `steer_r0` pivot nodes at the wheel centres. This own geometry is part of the CC BY-SA 4.0 derivative. The muzzle node was moved to the nose gun and parented to the hull. Needle triangles left by the kit's simplification were dropped. Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 8 degrees, no collapse. There is no `gun` part: the kit's only barrels are fixed ball mounts in the nose and tail.
